name: Executive search — confidential
description: Low-volume, high-discretion. Never names the client, never mentions a role in the invite note, and asks for a private channel before any detail moves. Built for searches where a leak is the failure mode.
audience: Senior operators — C-level, VP, founder-adjacent — on a confidential mandate. Small lists only, ten to thirty people.

variants: {{firstName|Hi}} — I run leadership searches in your sector and would value being connected. Nothing to ask you for today.
Hi {{firstName|there}} — I work on a small number of senior mandates each year, and yours is a name that comes up. Happy to connect.
Thank you, {{firstName|there}}. I'm running a confidential mandate I can't describe here. If it's of any interest, is there a private email or number I can use?
{{firstName|Hi}} — I have a search I'd rather not outline on this platform. Would you be open to a fifteen-minute call, entirely off the record?
No pressure at all, {{firstName|there}}. If the timing is wrong I'll simply close the file. If it's the discretion you're weighing, I'm happy to give references first.
Understood if this isn't a moment for it, {{firstName|there}}. Say the word and I'll not raise it again — or give me a time and I'll call you.
I'll leave it there, {{firstName|there}}. If you know someone the description might fit better, an introduction is worth more to me than a yes.
Closing this off, {{firstName|there}}. If a name comes to mind who ought to hear about it, I'd be grateful for the pointer.
